note: Hand-written hold-out emails. Not used to build or tune the rule engine or prompts; includes German, Czech and Spanish, sarcasm, forwards, out-of-office and phishing.

emails.subject: Reminder letters
emails.body:
Henrik here. I have now had to explain to our board why our customers receive dunning letters addressed to someone who left us two years ago. I would appreciate a call from someone senior today.

Henrik

emails.subject: Lastschriften SR 1-WQQRLY
emails.body:
Sehr geehrtes Support-Team,

seit gestern können wir keine Lastschriften mehr einziehen (SR 1-WQQRLY). Das betrifft unsere gesamte Monatsabrechnung. Bitte um dringende Rückmeldung bis morgen früh.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Paul Grant

emails.subject: Refundace SR 1-DFNEZ6
emails.body:
Dobrý den,

refundace pro SR 1-DFNEZ6 stále čeká. Náš zákazník hrozí odstoupením od smlouvy. Prosíme o vyřešení do pátku.

Gus

emails.subject: Automatic reply: Out of office
emails.body: I am out of the office until 12 October with limited access to email. For urgent matters please contact Marta Silva.

emails.subject: RE: SR 1-BXK5YW VAT lines
emails.body: Great, another week and the VAT lines are still missing from our invoices (SR 1-BXK5YW). Our auditors are going to love that.

emails.subject: ERP export
emails.body: Hi team, we have switched to the manual export for the time being, so the ERP queue issue (SR 1-MYH8K2) can wait until after your release next month. Thanks!

emails.subject: Q4 roadmap: critical path published
emails.body: FYI the critical path for the Q4 roadmap review is now published on the intranet. Please review before Friday.

emails.subject: Quarterly invoice currency
emails.body: Our external auditors arrive on 14 October, so we need the corrected currency on the quarterly invoice (1-7NL666) before then.

emails.subject: RE: SR 1-D88SSQ duplicate account
emails.body: Thanks Lucia, received. We will test it tomorrow and let you know.

emails.body:
Forwarding the note from our COO below. Please prioritise SR 1-UTEBR9.

emails.subject: Quarterly bill in USD again
emails.body:
Hello, our clinics received the quarterly bill in USD again instead of EUR. Finance needs the invoice corrected before the board pack goes out on Thursday.

Priya

emails.subject: Price list
emails.body: Could you send us the updated price list PDF when convenient? No hurry.

emails.subject: [OPS-1102] order confirmations
emails.body: Order confirmations were delayed by up to two hours again last night. Our warehouses are shipping blind until they arrive. [OPS-1102]

emails.subject: Portal feedback
emails.body: Just wanted to say the new self-service portal looks great. Well done to the team!

emails.subject: New contract prices
emails.body: The go-live for the new contract prices has been moved to January, so SR 1-WY2HPB is no longer time-critical for us.

emails.subject: Jerarquía de cuentas SR 1-JZZNHT
emails.body:
Hola, el problema de la jerarquía de cuentas (SR 1-JZZNHT) está bloqueando nuestra facturación consolidada. Necesitamos una solución esta semana.

Victor

emails.subject: RE: [OPS-1102] lag
emails.body: Reproduced OPS-1102. Root cause is a consumer rebalancing storm after the last deploy. Fix goes out tomorrow.

emails.body: Please note our legal department is now copied. The duplicate charges on our account (1-PBKAQR) must be reversed by Monday.

emails.body: This is really important for us. Please look at the reminder letters (1-UVQAZV) as soon as you can, our customers are confused.

emails.body: Heads up: we are onboarding 40 new stores next week, so the rate limit problem on the partner integration will get much worse from Monday.

emails.body: This week: how Company X survived a six-hour outage, and what your support team can learn from it.
